metadata.title: Before You Go From Wholesaling to Curative Title, Watch This
metadata.author: Courtney Fricke
metadata.shortDescription:
Thinking about making the jump from wholesaling into curative title investing?

You probably have more of a head start than you realize—but some of the habits that work in wholesaling can actually hurt you in curative title.

In this episode of the Messy Money Podcast, I break down what transfers from wholesaling, what you may need to unlearn, and why curative title requires a deeper level of problem solving, research, patience, and risk analysis.

We cover:

Why wholesalers aren't starting from zero
The difference between identifying problems and actually solving them
Why competency should come before scaling
Where your money is better spent in curative title
Why relying entirely on the title company can hurt you
Why speed isn't always an advantage
Why small spreads can be dangerous in curative deals
When to bring in attorneys, genealogists, investigators, and other professionals

Curative title isn't just wholesaling harder deals. It's learning how to understand messy title and ownership problems well enough to determine whether they can be solved—and whether there's enough profit to make solving them worthwhile.

ATTENTION:

The information shared in this episode is for educational and informational purposes only and reflects personal experiences and opinions. It is not intended as legal, tax, financial, or investment advice. Real Estate laws, tax rules, and regulations vary by state and situation. Always consult with a qualified attorney, CPA, or other licensed professional before making any Real Estate or financial decisions.
